abbu-to-csv.long: Converts the .abbu backup that Apple Contacts creates into a plain CSV spreadsheet — readable in Excel, importable anywhere, and not locked inside Apple's format.

backstage.long: Lists launchd jobs, cron and your scripts; runs scripts with live output and history; diagnoses and repairs broken LaunchAgents.

bigfiles.long: Scans your Mac and lists the largest folders and files by size, so you can see where the disk space actually went — old simulators, unused VMs, forgotten videos.

cleanicloud.long: Finds duplicate and large files in your iCloud Drive and walks you through deleting them interactively — useful when iCloud is full and Manage Storage isn't telling the whole story.

cpu-guard.long: Installs a background watcher that throttles macOS background processes when they stay hot too long, using quiet action-only notifications instead of repeated alerts.

drive-dedup.long: Scans an external drive for duplicates and consolidates everything into a clean folder structure. Runs in two phases: first it maps what's there, then it moves things around.

eastofeast-faq.short: FAQ content for a building website.
eastofeast-faq.long: FAQ content for a building website.

git-privacy.long: audit: every repo's private files, unpushed leaks and corruption · install: guard this Mac · scrub <repo> --apply: remove private files from unpushed commits.

github-autopush.long: Installs a background LaunchAgent that automatically commits and pushes your git repos to GitHub on a schedule. Set it up once and your projects stay synced without you remembering to push.

gmail-attachment-wingman-extension.short: Grabs attachments out of Gmail in bulk so you're not saving
gmail-attachment-wingman-extension.long: Grabs attachments out of Gmail in bulk so you're not saving them one click at a time.

google-voice-exporter-extension.short: Exports the open Google Voice thread as JSON, CSV, or TXT wi
google-voice-exporter-extension.long: Exports the open Google Voice thread as JSON, CSV, or TXT with attachment URLs and logs.

imessage-campaigns.long: Sends (and follows up on) birthday invites through Messages.app, with a dry-run mode to preview before anything goes out. Keeps its own sent-log in this folder.

imessage-sync.short: Nightly archive of every conversation, for people and AIs
imessage-sync.long: Every night: all conversations to Markdown + a searchable SQLite db, attachments sorted by type (photos/videos/PDFs/audio) and shrunk. Self-healing schedule, dashboard, doctor, per-person pipelines.

mac-migrator.short: Pack up your Mac for migration
mac-migrator.long: Bundles your Mac's configuration — shell settings, LaunchAgents, background tasks, dotfiles — into a portable archive you can restore on a new machine. Saves hours of reconfiguring from scratch.

mac-scripts-launcher.short: A native-feeling little app to browse and launch everything
mac-scripts-launcher.long: A native-feeling little app to browse and launch everything in this collection from one window.

meet-tab-sidecar-extension.short: Chrome extension for joining a Meet while a sidecar tab hand
meet-tab-sidecar-extension.long: Chrome extension for joining a Meet while a sidecar tab handles audio, intros, or presentation work.

openclaw-chatlog-tap.long: Reinstalls a working chatlog tap and reloads its LaunchAgent.

pdf-to-xls.long: Pulls tabular data out of a PDF and writes it to a spreadsheet — handy for statements, reports, and invoices that only come as PDFs.

personalcontacts-analyzer.long: Reads your Contacts database and produces stats about your network — who you have info on, gaps in your address book, duplicates, and missing emails or phone numbers.

rescue-hq.long: Everything for a Google Takeout photo rescue in one place. Checks and installs dependencies, merges a multi-part zip set, sorts the result into PHOTOS/ (one flat folder to drag-upload) and VIDEOS/<year>/ (flat, for stitching), and repairs common Takeout damage — Live Photo motion clips, duplicates, screenshots, JSON sidecars, and files whose extension lies about their contents. Dry-runs every stage and deletes nothing.

screenshot-tidy.long: Installs a background watcher that moves new Desktop screenshots into dated folders automatically, so they never pile up on your Desktop.

secrets-sweep.short: Find keys and secrets outside the vault
secrets-sweep.long: Audits a folder tree for keys and credential files; --fix moves them into the vault and leaves symlinks.

sunlight.long: Sunlight: power, brightness, colors, dedicated white, warm startup and on-device daylight automation, with private recovery backups.

voice-memo-renamer.short: Rename Voice Memos from a plan
voice-memo-renamer.long: Builds a rename plan for Voice Memos, applies it, and keeps rollback CSVs.

voicememocleaner.long: Exports every Voice Memo — full-quality original plus a smaller compressed copy — into one folder, along with title, date, duration, and GPS location metadata where available. Read-only against Voice Memos itself; nothing in the app is touched. Reruns are incremental, so refreshing after new recordings is fast.

whatsapp-campaigns.long: Finds private chats where a phrase appeared, lets you review each person and matching context, then simulates or sends a separate message to each. Archives campaigns, checks replies, and prepares bumps for people who did not respond. Dry-run is always the default.

opensore.short: AI-assisted workplace evidence investigation for lawyers, HR
opensore.long: AI-assisted workplace evidence investigation for lawyers, HR, boards, and compliance teams.

opensnore.short: A browser app, PWA, and Mac-app experiment with fake snores
opensnore.long: A browser app, PWA, and Mac-app experiment with fake snores for boring moments and guided exercises for quieter nights.

imessage-cleanup.short: Export per-person archives & free iCloud space
imessage-cleanup.long: Interactive exporter and iCloud storage cleaner: exports per-person archives (database, transcript, media) and frees space by removing local attachment copies.

repo2audiobook.short: Turn a GitHub repo into a narrated audiobook
repo2audiobook.long: Converts a GitHub repository into a narrated audiobook/podcast using OpenAI TTS, with modes like investor diligence, technical deep-dive, and beginner. Run setup once to install dependencies, then run repo2audiobook.py with a repo URL.

screenshot-mover.short: Screenshots to clipboard instantly, filed to iCloud
screenshot-mover.long: Every screenshot is on your clipboard the instant you take it, and filed into iCloud › Desktop › Screenshots for later review.

codex-openclaw-simulator.long: Duplicate of ~/Documents/root/message-bridge (identical src/). Kept on disk, never published.
